deliberation_metadata.synthesis_rationale: Deliberation evaluated 2 competing candidate analysis plans. Candidate 'CAND-ANCOVA-01' (ANCOVA) was selected under CONDITIONAL status. Methodological justification: Controls for baseline imbalances, Increases statistical power, Eliminates Lord's paradox. Disqualified candidates: CAND-POSTTEST-ANOVA-02 (One-Way ANOVA on Posttest Only) due to fatal design/assumption vulnerabilities persisted into canonical pitfall registry. Synthesized conditions addressed: Verify homogeneity of regression slopes (Group × Pretest interaction p > .05)..
